en: A black-and-white image of an old church-like building with a steep tiled roof and characteristic small, eye‑shaped dormer windows. The structure has tall, narrow arched windows along its side and a modest tower with an onion-shaped dome and spire. The exterior walls appear weathered. In front there is a low stone and brick wall with a small gate and steps leading up toward the entrance, and mature trees partly obscure the right side of the building. The photo has worn, slightly damaged edges, typical of an old postcard or historical photograph. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image.
